newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM precious metals end mixed, palladium weaker.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM precious metals end mixed, palladium weaker.

text.p: Yen-based Tokyo precious metals futures ended mixed on Tuesday, with palladium losing ground due to the expected resumption of Russian platinum group metals (PGM) exports to Japan, traders said.
Palladium futures ranged from unchanged to 18 yen per gram weaker. Benchmark April was flat at 584 yen.
Gold futures ranged from one yen per gram lower to six higher. Benchmark April closed up one yen at 1,280 yen.
"Palladium opened sharply lower, but prices were lifted off early lows as private investors tended to cover their shorts when prices dipped," one trader said.
